visual_logic.composition: A medium-wide shot of a toy-like Edmontosaurus in a Late Cretaceous woodland floodplain (Two Medicine Formation style). It has a flat, duck-like bill and no head crest.
visual_logic.action: The dinosaur is sitting next to a pile of tough, woody horsetails and pine needles. It is holding its cheek with one hand, looking frustrated because it cannot grind its food. Its mouth is slightly open, showing the 'battery' wall is missing a section.
visual_logic.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; emphasize the 'duck-bill' shape and the lack of a crest to differentiate it from Parasaurolophus.
